title: Job Openings at Agary Pharmaceutical Limited
content:
Agary Pharmaceutical Limited was established in 1992 as a national marketing company that specializes in the importation and distribution of medical and hospital consumables. In 2008, the company diversified into local manufacturing of drugs and till date, our commitment and drive has propelled our growth to a world class facility. We specialize in Hospital Consumables, Medical Equipment, Drug Manufacturing, quality German Supplements (Queisser) and Raw Materials for Drug Manufacturing.

From working with small businesses to big conglomerates, Agary Pharmaceutical Limited works round the clock to meet the needs of the healthcare sector by providing easy access to internationally certified quality products that assist in rendering effective healthcare services. 
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.)  Accountant 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Accountant will be responsible for managing financial records, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with financial policies and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and accounts
	Handle reconciliations, vouchers, and payment processing
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
	Ensure compliance with tax and statutory requirements
	Support audits and financial reviews
	Monitor expenses and budgets


Requirements


	HND/BSc in Accounting or Finance
	2–5 years of relevant work experience
	Professional qualification (ICAN/ACCA) is an added advantage
	Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel
	Strong analytical and reporting skills.


Application Closing Date: 30th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their resume to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Business Development Pharmacist

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a motivated and dynamic Business Development Pharmacist to join our team.
	In this role, you will support the growth and expansion of our pharmaceutical products and services by identifying opportunities, building client relationships, and assisting in strategic initiatives. Ideal candidates are proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a foundational understanding of the pharmaceutical market.


Requirements


	Bachelor of Pharmacy
	3-5 years of experience in product management, branding, medical marketing, in pharmaceutical space
	Must be a Licensed Pharmacist
	Strong understanding of drug mechanisms, formulations, and market dynamics.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Creative mindset with a keen eye for brand presentation, packaging, and messaging.
	Ability to collaborate across departments
	Familiarity with regulatory guidelines (NAFDAC, PCN, SON etc.) as they relate to promotional materials


Application Closing Date: 17th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

3.) Chemical Analyst

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a skilled Chemical Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative chemical analyses, ensuring compliance with industry regulations, and contributing to product quality control.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field.
	3 - 5 years of experience in a chemical analysis role (Pharmaceutical experience preferred).
	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
	Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and industry best practices.
	Ability to work independently and within a team.


Application Closing Date: 31st August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

     

    

        Click here to Apply

	We are recruiting for the Risk Control leadership development role at FoodCo Nigeria Limited, a leading multichannel retail company in Nigeria.

From our humble beginning as a small fresh foods stall in Bodija, Ibadan, Oyo State, we have grown to become a leading brand in South-West Nigeria. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Risk Control Officer

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo

Role Overview
     

            
    




	We are recruiting for the Risk Control leadership development role at FoodCo Nigeria Limited, a leading multichannel retail company in Nigeria.
	Interested applicants must have basic understanding of risk management concepts (Operational, financial and compliance risk) ethical standards, keen analytical and critical thinking skills, and the ability to communicate effectively while mitigating organizational risks.


Key Responsibilities


	Learning to identify, assess, and mitigate operational and financial risks across the organization.
	Assisting in the development and implementation of risk management policies and frameworks.
	Conducting risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities in business processes.
	Learning how to monitor compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
	Understudying managers/supervisors in the risk management and compliance team to develop both technical and soft skills.
	Assisting in preparing risk reports, dashboards, and analyses for management decision-making.
	Supporting incident investigations and recommending corrective actions.
	Learning to evaluate emerging risks and developing proactive mitigation strategies.
	Assisting in designing and executing internal controls and process improvements.
	Learning to use risk management software and tools to track, report, and analyze risks.


Requirements


	A Bachelor’s Degree / Higher National Diploma in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.
	0–2 years post NYSC experience.
	Minimum graduating GPA of second class upper / upper credit.
	Age limit: 27 years.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
	Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines.
	Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
	Self-starter, detail-oriented, and highly organized.
	Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
	Ability to adapt to new challenges in a dynamic environment while handling multiple projects.
	High work ethic, personal and professional integrity, positive attitude, and passion for excellence.
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
	Strong attention to detail and critical-thinking skills.
	Experience with risk management, compliance, and internal control software is an advantage.
	Student membership of professional bodies such as ICAN, ACCA, CFA, or IRM is an added advantage.
